name: ENVS 3100
title: Climate Resilience and Adaptation: Municipal Policy and Planning
description: (Also offered as ENVE 3100, EVST 3100.) An interdisciplinary study of climate change focusing on the local, municipal scale: impacts, policy, vulnerability and adaptation with emphasis on tools such as vulnerability assessments that help local communities determine priorities for adaptation efforts.
requirement_description: Open to juniors or higher; instructor consent required. Recommended preparation: ENVE 1000, EVST 1000, or NRE 1000.
